name: The Atrium
description: The warm ground floor of the tower — a sunlit stone atrium strung with paper lanterns, where the climb begins. This is the BASELINE band: cues are simple taps and the color->button mapping is the default Xbox face-button code (blue=X, green=A, red=B, yellow=Y), introduced two colors at a time so the decode reflex is taught gently before the tower starts subverting it. Legibility plan: a warm amber base with a single bright lantern-gold landmark that pops, plus cool teal accents for contrast so no color blends into mush. Distinct from its siblings by being the only fully warm, fully calm band — higher bands go cooler and busier.
